data.title: Request for proof of use of Bauspardarlehen funds
data.summary: Bauspar Beispielheim AG asks Bastian Musterquell to submit proof that the building-society loan (Bauspardarlehen) money is used for his apartment — either the heating company's invoice or the signed order — within 10 working days of the letter date (21 November 2026).
data.explanation: Before paying out your building-society loan, the lender needs proof that the money is really spent on your home: the heating firm's invoice or the signed order form. Submit this by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the payout will simply be postponed to the first day of the next month — no penalty, but your funds arrive later. Send a scan or copy to the address or email given.

key_facts.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.

Monatsersten.

items.title: Submit proof of use of the loan funds
items.action: Send the heating company's invoice or the signed order confirming the money is used for your apartment.
items.consequence: If the proof does not arrive in time, the loan payout will be postponed to the first day of the next month.
